343330.「ずいぶんと 骨が折れそうな化身だ。\n よりによって 光の河に現れるとは……。:
This incarnation looks like it's going to be
quite a challenge. Of all places, it had to
appear in the River of Light.

343331.「<cs_pchero>。修行の成果を見せてくれ。\n 共に 悪しき業風を断ち斬:
Show me the fruits of your training,
<cs_pchero>. Let's sever the evil winds of
karma together.

343339.「……驚いた。じつは ストームカイザー同士の\n 共闘というのは 容易なことでは:
...I was surprised. As it turns out, getting
two Storm Kaisers to fight side by side isn't
easy.

343340.「互いがまとう風が ぶつかりあい\n 勢いを削いでしまうことが 多くてね。\n:
A lot of the time, the winds surrounding us
collide and dampen each other's momentum. It
takes some effort to get a feel for that.

343341.「しかし おまえと共に 戦っている間\n 私はむしろ 追い風を得たような気分だっ:
But while I was fighting alongside you, I
actually felt as if I had the wind at my back.

343342.「片翼で飛んでいた鳥が 両翼を得たかのような\n そんな 安心感すら覚えた……。:
I even felt a sense of reassurance, as if a
bird that had been flying with only one wing
had suddenly gained a second wing.

343345.「ついに その姿を見せてしまったか。: So, you've finally shown your true colors.

343347.「もとより 頃合いだと思っていた……と言えば\n 少しは 格好がつくかな。:
If I say I'd always thought the time was
right... maybe that'll make me look a little
better.

343349.「太古の昔 風の神エルドナは\n 死にかけの小鳥に 神気をお与えになり\n １羽:
In ancient times, Eldona, the God of Wind,
bestowed divine energy upon a dying little
bird, thereby creating a spirit bird.

343351.「私は 神から ふたつの大きな使命を授かった。\n ひとつは おまえも知っての通:
God has entrusted me with two great missions.
One, as you know, is to purge, cleanse, and
seal away the Magatsukaze.

343352.「もうひとつは 風のチカラを利用した\n 唯一無二の剣術を 人々に伝え\n 優秀:
Another is to teach people a one-of-a-kind swordsmanship style that harnesses the power of the wind, to train outstanding warriors,
and to make it the sword that protects the world.

343353.「そのために エンスウは 人の姿を借りた。\n 何千年もの間 老いることなく\n:
To that end, Ensou took on human form. For
thousands of years, he remained Master Ensuu
without ever aging.

343354.「ずっと 探し求めていた。\n 人の限界を超え 世界に変革をもたらす者を。:
I've been searching for this person for a long
time--someone who transcends human limits and
brings about change in the world.

343355.「……その者 清らかなる黄金の翼を得て\n あまねく風を制覇する 無双の剣士なり:
That adventurer, cloaked in pure golden wings
and commanding every breeze, stands as a
peerless swordsman.

343356.「おまえに貸し与えていた 山吹の羽根は\n 私の風切り羽。時 ここに至りて\n:
The Sunblossom Feather I lent you is my own
flight feather. The time has come, so from
this day forward, it is yours.

343357.「我が弟子 <cs_pchero>。\n 風を知り 私の真の姿を知った者よ。\n:
My disciple, . You who have come to know the wind and my true form. Now, I shall bestow upon you the essence of Storm
Kaiser.

343358.身体中に 清らかなチカラが満ちていく。\n<cs_pchero>がまとう 風のチ:
Pure power surges through my body. The wind's
power surrounding <cs_pchero> has grown even
stronger!

343359.「我が弟子 <cs_pchero>。\n 風を知り 私の真の姿を知った者よ。\n:
My disciple . You who have come to understand the wind and have come to know my true form. Continue to devote yourself to
your training.

343360.身体中に 清らかなチカラが満ちていく。\n<cs_pchero>は 師父エンスウ:
Pure power surged through his body.
<cs_pchero> etched Master Ensuu's guidance
deep in his heart!

343361.「ストームカイザーとしての 実力をつけた\n 今のおまえならば マガツタタリカゼ:
Now that you've honed your skills as Storm
Kaiser, you should be able to hold your own
against The Winds of Dread.

343362.「いよいよ 使命を果たす時だ。\n 私と共に 最後の戦いに向かう覚悟が\n でき:
The hour of our quest has come. If you're
prepared to stand beside me in the final
battle, seek out my hermitage.

343365.「これ以上 マガツタタリカゼを放置できぬ。\n 一刻も早く エンスウと共に 使命:
I can't leave The Winds of Dread unattended any longer. You must fulfill your mission with Ensou as soon as possible. I'm counting on
you....

343366.<cs_pchero>たちは 創世の樹の頂から立ち去り\n光の河の上まで 戻った:
<cs_pchero> and the co. left Top of the
Worldroot and returned to the source of the
River of Light.

349240.師父エンスウと共に 創世の樹の頂に登ると\nけがれた風が 吹き荒れていた……。:
When I climbed to the Top of the Worldroot
with Master Ensuu, a foul wind was howling.
